notes: Cliopatria lacks the Portuguese Angolan frontier as a colony (its Portuguese rows are the Empire to 1823, Portugal, and 'Portuguese Africa' to 1581, which af-08 and am-06 own); this dossier is the colony as the group scope asks, built from pages opened for the neighbours. The shapes are conventions (80 km Luanda disc, 30 km Kwanza, 60 km Benguela, the Ndongo region, Cabinda, Benguela region for Viye, then all of Angola from 1920). Not settled by the pages: Benguela's founding year, Pungo Andongo (1671), Caconda, Moçâmedes, the Dembos, the Cuanhama and Kuvale campaigns, the 1891 and 1905 lines, the Lunda and Chokwe lands of the north-east, Matamba's integration year (so the 1683 vassal_start has no end), the 1599 Ndongo border. The Mbwila vassalage is not recorded as an event (the page says Portugal 'was unable to exercise any real authority'). Overlap: the neighbouring Cliopatria rows for Portugal (kingdom-of-portugal, portuguese-empire) already cover some coastal Angola; the colour agent and the renderers should decide whether the colony is drawn over them. Eight pages were opened (two of them for this dossier alone: Portuguese Angola, History of Angola). [Fix af-06, 2026-10-19: (1) BLOCKING shapes: the 1671-1884 and 1885-1919 shapes no longer use the gazetteer's 'Ndongo' region (Luanda, Bengo, Cuanza Norte, Malanje), which drew Matamba and Kasanje as the colony; they use the redrawn Ndongo of kingdom-of-ndongo (Bengo minus the Kongo shape, Cuanza Norte, the Lukala side of Malanje) and add Matamba only in 1836 and Kasanje only in 1910. The Kwanza corridor is now the stretch inside Cuanza Norte (the old river region drew the whole Kwanza, 177 cells). (2) The keyframes are split at every dated gain: 1617 Benguela, 1671 Ndongo, 1836 Matamba, 1885 Kongo land (the old shape left it out), 1890 Viye (the old shape had it from 1885), 1910 Kasanje, 1912 north-east, 1914 Mbanza Kongo (new, mirrors kingdom-of-kongo's dissolve), 1915 Cuanhama, 1920 all of Angola. (3) Matamba: the 1683 vassal_start now ends with a vassal_end and a gain in 1836 (Ambundu page); agrees with kingdom-of-matamba, whose dissolve moved from 1744 to 1836.
